about: The public keys that sign RELEASE-MANIFEST.json (ECDSA P-256, SHA-256, signature in IEEE P1363 form). The Hub reads this file from its own files; the desktop shell embeds the same file. Only an entry that says use "release" is a key. The entry below is a PLACEHOLDER: it holds no key, it verifies nothing, and scripts/verify-release-source.py refuses to release while a placeholder or a test key is in this file. To fill it in, run scripts/new-release-key.mjs with a path OUTSIDE the repository, replace the entry with the one it prints, and keep a second entry for the next key so that a rotation does not need a new installer first.
